name: smart_commit
description: Group the working-tree diff into atomic conventional commits. Input {dry_run, scope:staged|all, max_commits}. Lock files are excluded. A dependency cycle that spans every group falls back to one commit with a note. Prefer dry_run first.
llm_description: Group staged/unstaged files into conventional commits. {dry_run, scope:'staged'|'all', max_commits}. Lock files excluded. Degenerate import cycles become one commit + note. Prefer dry_run first.
